notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
I fixed a few things:

[list]
[*]Fixed bug where using "beneath a thunder shattering" to kill final boss prevented the final scene from playing
[*]Fixed bug where background didn't always load when continuing rung
[*]Fixed bug where restarting the game after winning wouldn't allow you to advance
[/list]

notes.title: New Starting Poetry Line
notes.content:
I've added a new poetry line that you begin with. It costs 1 Focus and has one Hope.

It's a third line and goes "seen with quiet satisfaction."

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Poem previews now take into account changes from the current poem
[*] Updated gain damage status effect image to a new one
[*] Moved status effects a bit further from one another, now they can breathe
[*] Targeting multiple enemies at once now has a delay between each animation
[*] Fixed a bug where status effects weren't triggering in multiples
[*] Added animation to Shame status effect
[/list]

[h2]Run[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where player couldn't advance through poems
[*]Fixed bug where sometimes the player wouldn't die when they reached 0 hit points (sorry)
[/list]

[h2]Postures[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed purple effect from triggered postures (it was causing bugs)
[*] Increased number of rounds Careful gives player Invincibility to 4
[/list]

notes.title: UI Update
notes.content:
[h1]UI Update[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Underline to poetry lines when they are selectable
[*]Changed the aesthetic of the "Return" button when in the screen to forget poetry lines, it now uses the button visuals from main menu
[*]Now status effects have their quantities in a circle at the bottom right corner
[/list]

notes.title: Save System Update
notes.content:
You can now leave a run and return where you left off.

The game will save your progress automatically when you exit.

notes.title: UI upgrades
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.4.3[/h1]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Damage types are now shown in poem previews
[*] Added backgrounds for attribute poem previews
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemies now no longer cover tooltip with health
[/list]

notes.title: Main Menu Upgrade
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.4.2[/h1]

[h2]Visual Upgrades[/h2]
[list]
[*] New main menu!
[*] Targeting mode now has a pencil-sketch background, making all your eligible targets stand out more clearly
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 'Faces' enemies now have correct colour of outline when targeted
[*] Trapped Dai's corruption no longer disappears at incorrect health values
[/list]

notes.title: Battle Poet's First Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.4.1[/h1]

[h2]Feature[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now replay the tutorial from the main menu
[/list]
[h2]Visual Upgrades[/h2]
[list]
[*] Enemies now float around at randomly increasing and decreasing speeds, making them feel more alive.
[*] Dialogue during encounters fades in more quickly.
[*] Enemy turn animations are snappier, looks more aggresive.
[*] Many minor improvements to fade in quality on art assets.
[/list]
[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added sound effect for applying status effect
[/list]
[h2]Encounters[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced amount of health on the Trapped Dai's corruption.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Audio change not applying when switching between run and tutorial.
[*] Status effects not fading in when effect is applied.
[*] Poetry lines being unusable when switching between run and tutorial.
[*] Attributes not appearing in run after going into a run from tutorial.
[*] Recite buttons appearing in front of death screen.
[*] Poem effect preview not disappearing when game is reset.
[*] Enemy visual effects not being reset between playthroughs of run.
[*] Player attributes not being reset when switching between tutorial and run.
[/list]
